Game Overview

At its heart, Cursed Treasure 1.5 is a strategy game about defend your cursed gems using strategic placement of unique towers. Balance your resources and magic across Orc, Undead, and Demon defenses to repel relentless foes. Unleash spells judiciously, upgrade towers wisely, and master the art of tactical synergy to protect your mystical treasures from falling into enemy hands.

How to Play

Cursed Treasure 1.5 keeps its controls loop simple so the focus stays on the challenge. Defend your cursed gems using strategic placement of unique towers. Balance your resources and magic across Orc, Undead, and Demon defenses to repel relentless foes. Unleash spells judiciously, upgrade towers wisely, and master the art of tactical synergy to protect your mystical treasures from falling into enemy hands.
